text: At the very start, God created the heavens and the earth.
Listen, the earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters, no cap.
Then God said, “Let there be light,” and just like that, light showed up.
Real talk, God saw the light, and saw that it was solid. God divided the light from the darkness.
Lowkey, God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. Then evening came, morning followed, and just like that, day one wrapped up, no cap.
Not gonna lie, God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
Real talk, God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and that’s exactly what happened, fr.
Real talk, God called the expanse “sky”. Then evening came, morning followed, and just like that, day two wrapped up, for real.
Not gonna lie, God said, “Let the waters under the sky be linked up to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and that’s exactly what happened.
Real talk, God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God looked it over and knew it was solid.
Okay so, God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth”; and that’s exactly what happened, for real.
Lowkey, the earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind, and God looked it over and knew it was solid.
Not gonna lie, then evening came, morning followed, and just like that, day three wrapped up, straight-up.
Okay so, God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night, and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth”; and that’s exactly what happened, no cap.
Not gonna lie, God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars, for real.
Real talk, God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God looked it over and knew it was solid, fr.
Okay so, then evening came, morning followed, and just like that, day four wrapped up, straight-up.
Real talk, God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

Real talk, God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God looked it over and knew it was solid.
Listen, God blessed them, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
Lowkey, then evening came, morning followed, and just like that, day five wrapped up, straight-up.
Okay so, God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind”; and that’s exactly what happened, no cap.
Listen, God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God looked it over and knew it was solid.

Real talk, God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
Lowkey, God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him. Male and female he created them, straight-up.

Lowkey, God blessed them. God told them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
God said, “Okay so, I’ve given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It’s gonna be your food.

Real talk, to every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there’s life, I’ve given every green herb for food;” and that’s exactly what happened, straight-up.
God checked out everything he made, and honestly, it was all pretty awesome. Then evening came, morning followed, and just like that, day six wrapped up.
Real talk, the heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished, straight-up.
Lowkey, on the seventh day God finished his work which he’d done, and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he’d done, for real.
Listen, God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he’d done, straight-up.
Okay so, this is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that God made the earth and the heavens, no cap.
Real talk, no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up, for God hadn’t caused it to rain on the earth. There wasn’t a man to till the ground,
but a mist headed up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground, fr.
Okay so, God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul, straight-up.
Okay so, God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the dude whom he’d formed.

Real talk, out of the ground God made every tree to grow that’s pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, straight-up.
Listen, a river headed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers, for real.
Real talk, the name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there’s gold;
and the gold of that land is solid. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there, no cap.
Okay so, the name of the second river is Gihon. It’s the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush, fr.
Okay so, the name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates, straight-up.
Real talk, God took the dude, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
Not gonna lie, God commanded the dude, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
but you won’t eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for in the day that you eat of it, you’re gonna definitely die.”
God said, “It isn’t good for the dude to be alone. I’m gonna make him a helper comparable to him.”

Out of the ground God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the dude to see what he’d call them. Whatever the dude called every living creature became its name.
Real talk, the dude gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field, but for man there wasn’t found a helper comparable to him.
God caused the dude to fall into a deep sleep. As the dude slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
God made a woman from the rib which he’d taken from the dude, and brought her to the dude.
The dude said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She’s gonna be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
Not gonna lie, so a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they’re gonna be one flesh.
Lowkey, the dude and his wife were both naked, and they weren’t ashamed.
Okay so, now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You won’t eat of any tree of the garden?’”
Okay so, the woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You won’t eat of it. You won’t touch it, lest you die.’”
Okay so, the serpent said to the woman, “You won’t definitely die,
for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you’re gonna be like God, knowing good and evil.”

Listen, when the woman saw that the tree was solid for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate, and she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
Okay so, their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves, no cap.
Listen, they heard God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the dude and his wife hid themselves from the presence of God among the trees of the garden.
Real talk, God called to the dude, and told him, “Where are you?”
The dude said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was shook, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”
Okay so, God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
Real talk, the dude said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
Okay so, God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

God said to the serpent, “Because you’ve done this, you’re cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You’re gonna go on your belly and you’re gonna eat dust all the days of your life.
I’m gonna put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He’s gonna bruise your head, and you’re gonna bruise his heel.”
To the woman he said, “I’m gonna greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. In pain you’re gonna bear children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he’s gonna rule over you.”

Real talk, to Adam he said, “Because you’ve listened to your wife’s voice, and ate from the tree, about which I commanded you, ‘You won’t eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You’re gonna eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
It’s gonna yield thorns and thistles to you, and you’re gonna eat the herb of the field.
By the sweat of your face are you gonna eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. Because you’re dust, and to dust you’re gonna return.”
Not gonna lie, the dude called his wife Eve because she’d be the mother of all the living.
Not gonna lie, God made coats of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them, no cap.
God said, “Listen, the dude has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
Real talk, so God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken, fr.
Lowkey, so he drove out the dude, and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
Real talk, the dude knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I’ve gotten a man with God’s help.”
Not gonna lie, again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground, fr.
Not gonna lie, as time passed, Cain brought an offering to God from the fruit of the ground, no cap.
Listen, Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. God respected Abel and his offering,
but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was seriously mad, and the expression on his face fell, straight-up.
Okay so, God said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen, no cap?
Listen, if you do well, won’t it be raised? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you’re to rule over it.”
Not gonna lie, Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him, for real.
Okay so, God said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
Lowkey, God said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground, no cap.
Lowkey, now you’re cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand, for real.
Not gonna lie, from now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You’re gonna be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”
Lowkey, Cain said to God, “My punishment is greater than I can bear, straight-up.

Check it out, you’ve driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I’m gonna be hidden from your face, and I’m gonna be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Anyone who finds me will kill me.”
Lowkey, God told him, “So, anyone who slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” God appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him wouldn’t strike him, for real.
Not gonna lie, Cain left God’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden, no cap.
Listen, Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch, for real.
Real talk, to Enoch was born Irad. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech, no cap.
Real talk, lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah, straight-up.
Lowkey, adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of people who live in tents and have livestock, no cap.
Lowkey, his brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe, no cap.
Lowkey, zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah, fr.
Lowkey, lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
Listen, if Cain will be avenged seven times, no cap Lamech seventy-seven times.”
Lowkey, Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
Real talk, a son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on God’s name, straight-up.
Real talk, this is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness, no cap.
Real talk, he created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them “Adam”, no cap.
Lowkey, Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth, for real.
Not gonna lie, the days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters, for real.
Okay so, all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died, for real.
Okay so, seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh, no cap.
Listen, seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters, for real.
Lowkey, all of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died, no cap.
Listen, enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan, no cap.
Lowkey, enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters, no cap.
Listen, all of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died, fr.
Okay so, kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel, for real.
Listen, kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died, fr.

Real talk, jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch, no cap.

Lowkey, all of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died, for real.
Not gonna lie, Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah, fr.
Okay so, after Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters, fr.
Real talk, all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years, straight-up.

Real talk, methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech, straight-up.
Not gonna lie, methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters, fr.

Okay so, lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son, straight-up.
Okay so, he named him Noah, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which God has cursed.”
Listen, lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters, no cap.
Lowkey, all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died, for real.

Okay so, when men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
Lowkey, God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were gorgeous, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
Real talk, God said, “My Spirit won’t strive with man forever, because he also is flesh, so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

Lowkey, the Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown, no cap.
Listen, God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil, fr.
Lowkey, God was sorry that he’d made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart, no cap.
Not gonna lie, God said, “I’m gonna destroy man whom I’ve created from the surface of the ground — man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky — for I’m sorry that I’ve made them.”
Okay so, but Noah found favor in God’s eyes, straight-up.
Real talk, this is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God, fr.
Real talk, Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth, straight-up.
Okay so, the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence, straight-up.
Okay so, God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth, straight-up.
God said to Noah, “I’m gonna bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Real talk, I’m gonna destroy them and the earth.
Not gonna lie, make a ship of gopher wood. You’re gonna make rooms in the ship, and will seal it inside and outside with pitch.
Lowkey, this is how you’re gonna make it. The length of the ship will be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
You’re gonna make a roof in the ship, and you’re gonna finish it to a cubit upward. You’re gonna set the door of the ship in its side. You’re gonna make it with lower, second, and third levels.
Listen, I, even I, do bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that’s in the earth will die, no cap.
But I’m gonna establish my covenant with you. You’re gonna come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
Of every living thing of all flesh, you’re gonna bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They’re gonna be male and female.
Real talk, of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive, fr.
Lowkey, take with you some of all food that’s eaten, and gather it to yourself, and it’s gonna be for food for you, and for them.”
Not gonna lie, thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him, no cap.
Not gonna lie, God said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I’ve seen your righteousness before me in this generation, straight-up.
Lowkey, you’re gonna take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that aren’t clean, take two, the male and his female.
Okay so, also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth, fr.
In seven days, I’m gonna cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I’m gonna destroy every living thing that I’ve made from the surface of the ground.”
Listen, Noah did everything that God commanded him, no cap.
Listen, Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth, for real.
Okay so, Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters, for real.
Lowkey, clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah, for real.
Not gonna lie, after the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth, straight-up.

Listen, in the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep were burst open, and the sky’s windows were opened, for real.
Not gonna lie, it rained on the earth forty days and forty nights, fr.
Listen, in the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth — Noah’s sons — and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship —

they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort, straight-up.
Lowkey, pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah, no cap.
Not gonna lie, people who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him, then God shut him in, fr.
Real talk, the flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and raised the ship, and it was raised above the earth, no cap.
Listen, the waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth, and the ship floated on the surface of the waters, fr.
Lowkey, the waters rose seriously high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
Lowkey, the waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered, no cap.
Real talk, all flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man, straight-up.
Okay so, all on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died, straight-up.

Lowkey, every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and people who were with him in the ship, no cap.
Real talk, the waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days, for real.
Okay so, God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship, and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided, for real.
Not gonna lie, the deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained, fr.
Not gonna lie, the waters continually went down from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters went down, no cap.
Listen, the ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains, for real.
Okay so, the waters went down continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible, straight-up.
Listen, at the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he’d made,
and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth, fr.
Not gonna lie, he himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship, straight-up.
Real talk, he waited yet another seven days, and again he sent the dove out of the ship, no cap.
Listen, the dove came back to him at evening and, no joke, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
Real talk, he waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove, and she didn’t return to him anymore, no cap.

Not gonna lie, in the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried, straight-up.
Lowkey, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry, straight-up.
Not gonna lie, God told Noah,
“Okay so, go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you, straight-up.

Lowkey, bring out with you every living thing that’s with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, so they can breed more than enough in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
Real talk, Noah headed out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, straight-up.
Okay so, every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, headed out of the ship, fr.
Listen, Noah built an altar to God, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar, for real.

Listen, God smelled the pleasant aroma. God said in his heart, “I won’t again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I’m never gonna again strike every living thing, as I’ve done.
Lowkey, while the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night won’t cease.”
Real talk, God blessed Noah and his sons, and told them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth, for real.

Okay so, the fear of you and the dread of you’re gonna be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
Lowkey, every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I’ve given everything to you, no cap.
Not gonna lie, but flesh with its life, that’s, its blood, you won’t eat, straight-up.

I’m gonna definitely require your blood of your lives. At the hand of every animal I’m gonna require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I’m gonna require the life of man.
Listen, anyone who sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image, no cap.
Okay so, be fruitful and multiply. Increase more than enough in the earth, and multiply in it.”
Okay so, God talked to Noah and to his sons with him:
“Okay so, as for me, check it out, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
and with every living creature that’s with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth, no cap.
Real talk, I’m gonna establish my covenant with you: All flesh won’t be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
Okay so, God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that’s with you, for perpetual generations:
Okay so, I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it’s gonna be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
Listen, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
and I’m gonna remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh, fr.
Lowkey, the rainbow will be in the cloud. I’m gonna look at it, so I can remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that’s on the earth.”
Listen, God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I’ve established between me and all flesh that’s on the earth.”
Real talk, the sons of Noah who headed out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan, straight-up.
Real talk, these three were Noah’s sons, and from these, the whole earth was populated, for real.
Lowkey, Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard, fr.
Not gonna lie, he drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent, for real.
Lowkey, Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside, no cap.

Real talk, Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness, for real.
Lowkey, Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him, for real.
Okay so, he said, “Canaan is cursed. He’s gonna be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
Real talk, he said, “Blessed be God, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant, fr.
